errors.unlock.locked: Boba can't read the key for your data. Enter your passphrase, or retry reading the key.
errors.unlock.no_keychain: This machine has no keychain, so Boba needs a passphrase. Pick one you will remember: it is the only way back into your data.
errors.unlock.no_passphrase: This database was not created with a passphrase, so a passphrase can't open it.
errors.unlock.wrong_passphrase: That passphrase doesn't open your data. Check it and try again.
errors.unlock.kdf: Boba could not turn your passphrase into a key. Try again.
errors.unlock.store: Boba could not open your data. Restart Boba and try again.
